newsitem.title: UK: Singapore Airlines gets Airline of the Year award.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Airlines gets Airline of the Year award.

text.p: Singapore Airlines (SIA) was voted Airline of the Year on Thursday in an annual poll of readers of the British-based consumer magazine Executive Travel.

SIA, which finished ahead of Dubai government-owned Emirates airline and Cathay Pacific Airways, also won the categories for best airline to the Far East, top long-haul carrier, best ground/check in and best airport lounges.
There are 26 categories as well as the overall award and British Airways collected the highest number of awards with a total of 11.
These included best airline to Africa and best to the Caribbean, Central and South America.
Among the six awards won by Virgin Group's Virgin Atlantic was the best long-haul business class and best in-flight entertainment.
UAL Corp's United Airlines was voted best transatlantic carrier, while AMR Corp's American Airlines won the award for top U.S. domestic carrier.
Swissair, last year's overall winner, was voted best First Class cabin and best short-haul business class.
The award is voted by the magazine's 48,000 readers and by its 2,500 member Travel Check team', who monitor the world's leading airlines on quality of service.
